name: @iflow-mcp/pinzonjulian-stimulus-docs-mcp-server

tools.name: handbook-origin
tools.description: Learn why Stimulus was created by DHH - covers the philosophy of modest JavaScript frameworks, server-rendered HTML, and how Stimulus differs from mainstream JavaScript frameworks like React

tools.name: handbook-introduction
tools.description: Introduction to Stimulus core concepts: controllers, actions, targets, and values. Explains how Stimulus enhances server-rendered HTML and separates content from behavior

tools.name: handbook-hello
tools.description: Step-by-step tutorial for building your first Stimulus controller - covers creating a greeting controller with targets, actions, and DOM event handling

tools.name: handbook-building
tools.description: Build a real-world clipboard controller example - demonstrates practical Stimulus patterns, CSS classes, and connecting JavaScript to HTML elements

tools.name: handbook-resilience
tools.description: Best practices for building robust Stimulus applications - covers progressive enhancement, graceful degradation, and handling edge cases

tools.name: handbook-state
tools.description: Learn how Stimulus manages state through values and data attributes - covers reactive programming patterns and keeping state in sync with the DOM

tools.name: handbook-external
tools.description: Techniques for integrating external APIs and resources - covers AJAX requests, working with third-party libraries, and asynchronous operations

tools.name: handbook-installing
tools.description: Complete guide to installing Stimulus in your application - covers Webpack, import maps, Rails integration, and manual setup options

tools.name: reference-actions
tools.description: Complete reference for Stimulus actions - covers action descriptors, event handling, keyboard filters, global events, action parameters, and event options like :prevent and :stop

tools.name: reference-controllers
tools.description: Controller API reference - covers controller lifecycle, scopes, nested controllers, cross-controller communication with events, and registration patterns

tools.name: reference-css-classes
tools.description: CSS classes API reference - learn how to dynamically manage CSS classes in Stimulus controllers for styling and visual state management

tools.name: reference-lifecycle
tools.description: Controller lifecycle callbacks reference - covers connect(), disconnect(), and target connection/disconnection callbacks for managing controller state

tools.name: reference-outlets
tools.description: Outlets API reference - learn how to connect controllers to each other for component communication and coordination between different parts of your application

tools.name: reference-targets
tools.description: Targets API reference - covers target definitions, properties (singular/plural/existential), shared targets, optional targets, and target lifecycle callbacks

tools.name: reference-typescript
tools.description: TypeScript integration guide - covers type definitions, strongly typed targets/values/outlets, and best practices for using Stimulus with TypeScript

tools.name: reference-values
tools.description: Values API reference - covers value definitions, type coercion, change callbacks, and using values for reactive data binding between HTML and JavaScript
